description: Claim the profile behind a show as the person it is about. Needs an OpenAccess bearer with scopes openprofile:edit and email in the Authorization header; the claim goes through when the token's address is the feed's itunes:owner address, or when the show's site or feed description links to the profile URL. Nothing else is needed, and nobody reviews it.
name: claim_openprofile
title: Claim a podcaster's profile
